answer: The hollow counter is kept in meadow and wander shows each reset. An farming party therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 47 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 47 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 194 aliases cost 100 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
